step-1.text: Open the box in the room the bed will live in. Lay every part out on the flattened carton and match the hardware to the parts list.

count-1.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-2.text: Lay out both side rails and fold or screw their legs down so they stand on their own.

step-3.text: Join the head rail and the foot rail between the side rails, one bolt per corner to start. Leave them a little loose until the frame is square.

count-3.text: This step uses 2 end rails and 4 bolts.

step-4.text: Drop the center beam in from head to foot and stand up its three support legs. The middle of the bed carries the most weight, so make sure every foot touches the floor.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 center beam and 2 bolts.

step-5.text: Measure corner to corner both ways. When the diagonals match, the frame is square. Now tighten every bolt.

count-5.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-6.text: Stand the headboard at the head end and bolt it to the frame, two bolts each side. A helper holds it upright while you thread the first bolt.

count-6.text: This step uses 1 headboard and 4 bolts.

step-7.text: Lay the slats across the frame and drop them into their slots or straps, evenly spaced. Thirteen of them, no gaps wider than your manual allows.

step-8.text: Push the bed into place, check it does not rock, and lay the mattress on. No box spring needed on a platform bed.

count-8.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your MIA metal platform bed (twin) is built. Give it a proud little pat.
